people_visible: The mother in a black one-piece swimsuit and the father in a straw fedora, sunglasses and blue board shorts
event: Standing together in shallow turquoise water with the Atlantis Paradise Island Royal Towers directly behind them - the Bahamas
theme: Vacations; Marriage; Adventure; The life we built
notes: COUPLE ALONE at Atlantis in the Bahamas, with the resort clearly identifiable - very likely the honeymoon, though nothing in the frame proves it outright. Sharp, bright and the best-looking print of the later era.

people_visible: The father in a pink shirt walking away from camera at dusk carrying the youngest daughter on his hip, holding the middle daughter's hand, with the eldest in a white dress walking ahead
event: Walking back along a marina dock at dusk after dinner, all seen from behind
theme: Fatherhood; Vacations; Parenthood; The life we built
notes: Backs-turned dusk frame of a father hauling one daughter, leading another by the hand and following the third — motion-blurred and dark, but it carries more than any posed shot on the sheet.

people_visible: Father standing chest-deep in clear turquoise water with both arms raised, the three daughters hanging off him and floating around him
event: Playing in the sea, the father hoisting all three girls at once
theme: Fatherhood; Vacations; Humor; Family of five
notes: Arms up in triumph with a daughter clamped to each side and the youngest floating in front in pink armbands — genuine, physical joy. Bright water, clean exposure, holds the screen easily.

people_visible: The couple kissing on a patterned sofa; he in a white vest and navy backwards cap, she in a white t-shirt leaning into him
event: A quiet kiss on the sofa of a wood-panelled cabin or lake house
notes: The single most intimate frame in the batch: the two of them alone, mid-kiss, no audience, warm afternoon light through the curtain. Same weekend as S027, S028 and S029.

people_visible: young couple
event: Poolside/deck, he kisses her
notes: A kiss on a sunlit deck, drink in her hand. Precisely dated May 2007 - eight days after S067, so likely the same trip.

people_visible: Mother visibly pregnant in a floral swimsuit, father in blue trunks, and two daughters (one held on his hip, one standing in front)
event: Beach portrait late in the third pregnancy
theme: Family growth; Becoming parents; Vacations; Family of four
notes: The clearest 'family of four, about to be five' frame in the batch: the bump is unmistakable and both older girls are in the shot. A natural hinge point in the documentary.

people_visible: young couple
event: In the water in front of the Atlantis resort, Bahamas
notes: Standing in turquoise water with Atlantis behind. A strong candidate for the honeymoon or a major early trip - worth confirming which.

people_visible: The father in sunglasses and the mother, both in the sea
event: The two of them swimming together in clear turquoise ocean, heads and shoulders above water
notes: COUPLE ALONE in the ocean, both laughing - gorgeous water colour and one of the most joyful, filmic frames here. Strong hero candidate.

people_visible: visibly pregnant mother in a swimsuit sitting on a boat bench with a small child in a life jacket beside her
event: on a pontoon boat on a lake during pregnancy, a toddler in a life vest tucked against her
theme: Becoming parents; Family growth; Motherhood; Vacations
notes: A rare pregnancy frame - bare bump, life jacket, lake water behind - documenting a family about to grow again. Soft, slightly blown-out phone capture, but almost nothing else in the archive shows a pregnancy.

people_visible: The three daughters kneeling and lying in a pile on white sand at dusk, in swimsuits, laughing toward the camera
event: The three sisters playing in the sand at last light with the resort and palms behind them
notes: Wide, quiet dusk frame: three sisters tangled together on empty sand under a pastel sky and palm silhouettes. Composition and light both hold up for a long screen hold.

people_visible: The couple on the cabin sofa; he in a black beanie and white t-shirt, she in a pale blue sweatshirt, each holding a glass of red wine
event: Toasting with wine glasses in the cabin living room
notes: A wine toast, just the two of them, in a borrowed cabin - reads as one of their first trips away together. Print is slightly crooked with the curtain dominating the top third.

people_visible: The father and the youngest daughter side by side, both sticking their tongues out and crossing their eyes for the camera, in a busy shop or ice-cream counter
event: Silly face-pulling selfie with a striped drink cup on the counter beside them
theme: Humor; Fatherhood; Everyday life; Growing together
notes: Father and daughter pulling identical goofy faces, tongues out — the mirroring is the whole point and it lands. Busy background, but the two of them dominate.

people_visible: The father in a navy ball cap and white tank with the mother in red athletic shorts
event: The two of them at a marina, posed in front of a large white sportfishing boat, palm trees and a canal behind
notes: COUPLE ALONE on an early trip south; the scan is sideways but the print itself is sharp and well exposed. Their youngest faces of the whole batch.

people_visible: father in a team jersey and sunglasses and mother in a knit beanie, cheek to cheek in a selfie in a stadium
event: the two of them at a cold-weather football game - COUPLE ALONE, no children in frame
theme: Young love; Adventure; Growing together; Sports
notes: COUPLE ALONE - one of the scarce frames of just the two of them, grinning in the cold at a game. Phone-selfie quality but genuine, unposed warmth.

people_visible: young couple
event: Harbor visit, tall ship behind
notes: Arm in arm on a waterfront with a tall ship's rigging behind. Early dating years.

people_visible: The father in a dark cap and swim trunks with the mother in a tank top
event: Sitting together on a boat deck or sandbar with drinks, two yachts anchored in turquoise water behind them
notes: COUPLE ALONE in the Caribbean/Bahamas on an early trip; genuinely beautiful light and water colour, one of the technically best prints in the batch.

people_visible: The couple on the same patterned sofa; he in a white vest and backwards cap laughing upward, she curled against his chest
event: Lounging together on the cabin sofa, both laughing at something off-camera
notes: The laughing companion frame to the kiss in S026 - she is folded into him with her hands clasped in his. Couple alone, well exposed.

people_visible: The mother wearing a 'Happy Birthday' tiara sitting on the father's lap
event: Her birthday celebration on a deck at night, he in a striped dress shirt, she in a bright print tube top
notes: COUPLE ALONE at one of her birthdays during the dating years - the tiara makes the occasion unambiguous. Night flash, heavy red cast on his face.

people_visible: young couple
event: Marina at sunset
notes: Backlit by a marina sunset, arms out mid-laugh. Visually one of the prettiest early frames.

people_visible: The mother in a grey tank and the father with a shaved head and aviator sunglasses
event: Arm's-length self-portrait in a resort courtyard with tiled roofs and palms behind
notes: COUPLE ALONE, both genuinely laughing into the lens - the most spontaneous couple frame on sheet 4. Good light, slightly soft.

people_visible: An older woman in a black hat at left, a small daughter in a pink mask, an older daughter in a hooded coat, the father taking the selfie in a striped mask, and the mother in a green mask and white beanie
event: Family outing to the Rockefeller Center Christmas tree in New York, everyone in winter coats and face masks
notes: The lit Rockefeller tree fills the background while five masked faces crowd the lens. An older woman, most likely a grandmother, is with them; the youngest daughter is not in this frame.

people_visible: young couple
event: Outside a pastel resort building, palms
notes: Embracing in swimwear outside a tropical resort. Early trip together.

people_visible: young couple
event: On a beach lounger
notes: Sharing a lounger on the sand, relaxed and sunburnt. Same trip as S072.

people_visible: All three daughters standing barefoot on a lawn by the lake, each holding a large red heart-shaped award plaque; the oldest wears a novelty headband, and a boy is partly cut off at the left edge
event: Awards night at a lake camp or club; each girl holds the plaque she was given, one reading 'Best Sportsmanship'
notes: All three girls holding hand-painted awards with their names on them at the lake; the specificity of the plaques makes this a real milestone frame rather than a generic group pose.

people_visible: The couple lying together on the settee inside a boat's cabin; she in a blue t-shirt, he beneath her grinning, striped cushions around them
event: Below decks on a motor boat - varnished wood table, galley sink and fridge visible, a drinks can on the counter
notes: Distinctive setting - a boat cabin - with the couple alone and clearly enjoying themselves. Rare location in this collection.

people_visible: Father lying back in shallow pool water lifting the toddler daughter overhead; two other figures, one appearing to be the older daughter, are in the water behind them
event: Play in a shallow pool - the father launching the toddler into the air
notes: Unusual overhead-into-water composition; the child is mid-air with legs kicking. The background figures are too small to identify with certainty.

people_visible: Mother in a blue patterned swimsuit standing in the surf with two young daughters pressed against her legs
event: Standing in the shallow surf together at the ocean
notes: The girls cling to her hips with their backs half-turned while she smiles down the lens; low camera angle makes her the anchor of the frame. Physical affection, not a pose.

people_visible: Mother, father holding the youngest daughter in a sun hat, and two older daughters in swimsuits in front, at the ocean
event: Family beach portrait, all five together
theme: Family of five; Vacations; Family growth
notes: The counterpart to the pregnant beach frame a year earlier — same shoreline setup, now with the third daughter on the father's arm. Reads as a deliberate annual marker.

people_visible: The couple on striped beach loungers; he in a bucket hat and blue floral swim shorts with a drink, she in a blue bikini
event: A day on a crowded resort beach, palms and beach umbrellas behind, storm clouds overhead
notes: Their first holidays together as a couple - relaxed, drinks in hand, on matching loungers. Probably the same trip as S032, S034, S035 and S040.

people_visible: The mother in a black one-shoulder top and sunglasses with the father in a dark tee
event: A day out on the Philadelphia waterfront - the blue Benjamin Franklin Bridge and a moored tour boat are behind them, with a Captain Morgan bar umbrella
theme: Adventure; Young love; The life we built
notes: COUPLE ALONE with an identifiable city landmark behind them, which makes it useful for grounding the film geographically. Good daylight exposure.

people_visible: The father in a black bandana and tank top with the mother, sunglasses pushed up on her head
event: Close together on a boat or under a shelter on a hot day, both tanned and squinting
notes: COUPLE ALONE, very warm and relaxed with each other - one of the better later-era couple frames. Slightly soft and overexposed at the edges.

people_visible: father, mother, two daughters
event: Fall outing / pumpkin patch
notes: Hay bales, autumn. Clean seasonal marker.

people_visible: The mother in a Santa hat and a young daughter in white dragging a cut fir tree toward camera, the father at right holding the saw aloft, and one more person behind them
event: Cutting down a Christmas tree at a tree farm and hauling it out of the rows
notes: Mid-action frame: the tree is down and being dragged, the father is brandishing the saw like a trophy. A fourth figure behind the tree is too obscured to identify.

people_visible: The father in an olive polo and sunglasses with the mother in a pink top and sunglasses; a third person's hand and phone in the foreground
event: Posed together on the deck of a shore/beach house while someone else photographs them
notes: COUPLE ALONE at a beach house, with a period-accurate flip phone accidentally in frame - a strong incidental dating clue. Slight tilt and a foreground obstruction.

people_visible: The father in a pink shirt and white trousers and the mother in a long white dress with a gold kimono, standing together on a resort path
event: Dressed-up couple portrait before a resort dinner
theme: Vacations; Marriage; Growing together; The life we built
notes: Full-length, well-lit portrait of the two of them dressed for an evening out, palms and colonial architecture behind. The strongest 'still a couple' frame in this batch.

people_visible: The father, shirtless in a ball cap, standing on a lake dock with all three daughters in red-white-and-blue swimsuits clustered around him
event: Fourth of July at the lake, posing on the dock before swimming
theme: Fatherhood; Vacations; Holidays; Family of five
notes: Dad on the dock with all three girls in patriotic suits, the youngest tucked in front of him; open water and hills behind make a clean, warm frame.

people_visible: Father walking hand-in-hand with a young daughter toward the water; a second child crouched on the shore behind them
event: Walking down to the edge of a lake
notes: Backs to the camera, the held hand at the center of the frame, wide empty lake and treeline beyond. Reads as a classic parent-and-child silhouette without being posed.

people_visible: Mother in a purple tank with an iced drink, father in a white polo and cap taking the selfie, and all three daughters
event: Family selfie at a professional golf tournament beside the water on a bright day
theme: Family of five; Vacations; Sports; The life we built
notes: All five faces crowded into one arm's-length frame, everyone genuinely laughing, tournament flags and a pond behind. The middle daughter's braces date it precisely.

people_visible: The mother alone, seated on the gunwale of a boat with her hair blown back, holding a straw hat in her lap and looking out to sea
event: Quiet moment on the boat, looking out at the water
notes: Rare solo portrait of the mother — turned away from the camera toward the horizon, wind in her hair, clean sky and sea behind. Reads as a breath in the middle of the trip.

people_visible: The mother and the father in sunglasses, at the edge of a resort pool
event: Leaning on the pool edge together in the late afternoon, towels spread on the deck
notes: COUPLE ALONE at the pool on the same holiday as S102 (stamps 28 and 29 on consecutive days). Nicely lit late-afternoon colour, no year in the stamp.
